transcript: Most people don't need a new life, they just need a new rhythm. When you slow down for even a moment, you begin to notice the things you usually ignore, your breath, your thoughts, your inner space. Not in a medical way, just in a human way, a way of reconnecting with yourself. And over the past months, so many people have reached out to me saying the same thing. Yang, I feel like I just need guidance, a path, something steady to hold onto each day. That is exactly why I created my 30-day healing journey. Not to fix you, not to promise miracles, but to guide you gently into a calmer, more intentional rhythm. Every day, we focus on one small practice, reflection, breathing, awareness, gratitude. Nothing heavy, nothing extreme, just simple steps that help you feel more centered, grounded, and connected to your life again. I decided to open this journey for only the first 100 people, so it stays small, peaceful, and personal. Like a quiet circle you can return to each day. So if you've been craving clarity, a calm structure, a month of gentle routines that feel good to your spirit, then this journey might be exactly what you need right now. You can find the link on my profile.
